name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-walljump-poses
title: Super Mario World Styled Walljump Poses
description:
Super Mario World Styled Walljump Sprites, this is a edited rip from MFGG, original sprites by AwesomeZack.

The GFX file comes with Small, Big, & Tanooki versions for Mario/Luigi. Plus Small and Big Helmet Mario sprites. Top row is very edited, bottom is more like the original.

Instructions on how to insert are in the txt file.

Includes a modified Wall Kick patch that changes the tilemap, for easier insertion.
